steps.detail: The tutorial says: Any square sheet will work. source_texts.origami_me_cup:
How to Make an Easy Origami Cup
The traditional origami cup is one of the simplest (and most useful) models you can fold.
It takes less than a minute to make and works surprisingly well as a small container. You can use it to hold nuts, popcorn, or little items like paper clips or beads. This model has been around for over a century, and it’s still folded today for the same reason it always was: it’s quick, clever, and actually practical.
If you’re just starting out with origami, this is the perfect place to begin.
Origami Cup Step-by-Step Instructions
Difficulty: Easy – Beginner Level 1
Folding time: 1 minute
Recommended Paper
Any square sheet will work. Here, we used a 6 x 6 in (15 x 15 cm) sheet of origami paper (Kami).
Step 1
Start with the white side of the paper facing up, positioned like a diamond. Fold the paper in half diagonally by bringing the bottom corner up to meet the top corner.
Step 2
Fold the top layer’s left edge to the bottom edge, but only pinch at the right edge level. This creates a small reference point.
Step 3
Fold the left corner to the pinch made in the previous step. Then, crease well.
Step 4
Fold the right corner up to meet the left corner. Then, crease well.
Step 5
Fold the top flap’s top corner down, aligning it with the top edge of the cup.
Step 6
Mountain fold the top triangle to the back, aligning it with the top edge of the cup.
🍵 Folding tip: Tuck that flap inside the cup to show off more of the patterned side!
Step 7
Open the top layers of the cup and press down on the bottom to flatten it.
Ta-da! The Finished Paper Cup
And that’s it! Your origami cup is ready to use. Now what will you put in it?
Whether you’re folding it for fun or actually filling it with snacks, this little model proves that origami doesn’t need to be complex to be satisfying.
If you enjoyed this fold, be sure to join our newsletter and subscribe to our YouTube channel for more quick and fun tutorials.
And as always, feel free to share your creations with us on socials or in the comments. We love seeing what you make.
source_texts.origami_me_square:
How to Make Rectangular Paper into a Square
If you’re just getting started with origami and don’t have square paper yet, don’t worry. You can easily use regular printer paper instead.
While origami paper is easier to work with, most of our easy tutorials work perfectly well with standard printer paper (A4 or letter).
In this guide, we’ll show you how to turn a rectangular sheet of paper into a perfect square in just three simple steps.
Origami Rectangle Paper to Square Step-by-Step Instructions
Difficulty: Easy – Beginner level 1
Folding time: Under 1 minute
Step 1
Fold the left edge down to meet the bottom edge. Make a small pinch mark at the top right corner, then unfold.
Step 2
Fold the right edge over to the left along the dashed line, using the pinch mark you just made as a guide. Align all edges carefully before creasing. Crease well, then unfold.
Step 3
Cut off the right strip along the crease made in Step 2.
🎉 Your Square Is Complete
That’s it, you now have a perfect square sheet ready for origami. Once you’ve done it a couple of times, you’ll be able to make one in seconds.
Happy folding!
